title: Loss is Not Behavior: A Unified Output-Space Analysis of Gradient-Based Machine Unlearning
summary: Analysis and trained-model experiments show that similar loss-space behavior can coexist with different output-space gaps from retraining. The paper proposes leverage-based diagnostics; nonlinear conclusions are bounded by a local Gauss–Newton approximation.
ai_technology: Gradient-based machine-unlearning methods; output-space and leverage diagnostics
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: Theoretical analysis derives output-gap expressions for linear regression and uses generalized Gauss–Newton/local-linearity approximations for nonlinear models; empirical evaluation compares forget/retain outputs with retraining.
evidence.unknown: Nonlinear conclusions are limited to local approximations and tested methods; diagnostics do not guarantee successful unlearning.
evidence.ai_role: The paper analyzes gradient-based machine unlearning through forget/retain losses and output-space deviations from retraining, deriving leverage diagnostics.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
